summary: Iter180 Payouts Hub enhancements (history, insights, instant cash-out, weekly email digest) tested end-to-end on backend + web + mobile. All 16 backend tests pass. Web /payouts and mobile /payouts both render the new Fee Insights (empty state) and Payout History (empty state) sections; instant cash-out button is correctly hidden because demo merchant is not payout-ready; existing PENDING/Finish-Stripe-setup CTA still surfaces. Weekly digest endpoint returns ok/provider_live:true/sent:0 for admin, is rejected for non-admins. Cashout endpoint never 500s and always returns dashboard_url on fallback (verified over multiple calls). Regression: /api/payouts/overview + /api/admin/vendor-fees still work; /api/vendor-payments/* still 404.
critical_code_review_comments: PayoutsOnboarding.jsx still uses window.alert() for cash-out fallback/error messaging (lines 153, 156, 159). Non-blocking; consider a toast for a better UX, and pass the mapped copy from CASHOUT_MSG for known reasons.
payouts_hub.py hard-codes preview host as fallback in _frontend_url() (line 58). Cosmetic only — _origin() prefers request Origin/Referer.
Mobile payouts.tsx silently swallows cashout errors (catch {}). At minimum log or surface a subtle toast so users know when the API call failed vs succeeded.

History endpoint returns transactions from dream_payouts / payment_transactions_v2 with limit(50) but sort is descending on created_at — sorted output is not stable if created_at is missing; consider a secondary sort key.
test_credentials: demo@bigfm.dubai / DemoPass123! (web login + mobile demo login), admin@bigfm.dubai / AdminPass123!
seed_data_creation: None. Demo merchant remains non-payout-ready (as documented in iter179).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Demo merchant still has stripe_account_id but charges_enabled=false (state carried over from iter179). To exercise populated history/insights/cash-out-ready UI, either: (a) flip businesses.stripe_charges_enabled=true for biz_demo_marketplace and insert payment_transactions_v2 docs with status='succeeded' and created_at within the last 6 weeks, or (b) complete a real Stripe TEST KYC via /payouts/onboard. The cash-out button only appears when a.ready is true (charges_enabled OR payouts_enabled).
